title: Comfort Club Accessory Member Discount on Replacement System Installations Contracts
content:
# Accessory member discount — entitlement and posting

## Rule

A Comfort Club member whose agreement is in active status on the date the accessory member discount is posted receives one accessory member discount covering every accessory charged on the Replacement System Installations contract, posted once per contract as an accessory member discount naming the contract's highest-priced accessory charge; a homeowner whose agreement is not in active status on that date receives none.

## Entitlement grid

| Comfort Club agreement on the posting date | Accessories charged on the contract | Accessory member discount |
|---|---|---|
| Active | One or more | One discount covering every accessory, naming the highest-priced accessory charge |
| Not active (pending, past due, lapsed, cancelled) or no agreement | Any | None |

## Business effect

Posting the discount records one accessory member discount on the project ledger, naming the contract's highest-priced accessory charge, the accessory of that charge and the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, dated the day it is posted. The amount the homeowner owes on the project falls by exactly the discount, and the project's money history shows the accessory member discount.

## Tool: `post_accessory_member_discount_3312a288`

**Capability.** Posts the Comfort Club accessory member discount on an installation contract's accessories: one discount entry on the project's ledger covering the accessories charged on the contract, for the amount given, dated today.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_accessory_member_discount_3312a288` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `install_id` | The reference number of the installation project being credited, as shown by the installation project lookup for this homeowner | Text identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's customer profile, as shown by the customer profile lookup | Text identifier |
| `agreement_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement the discount is earned under, as shown by the Comfort Club agreement lookup | Text identifier |
| `source_entry_id` | The reference number of the contract's highest-priced accessory charge entry, which the discount names, as shown by the installation ledger lookup | Text identifier |
| `accessory_code` | The accessory of the named charge, exactly as written on that accessory charge | One of `smart_thermostat_upgrade`, `whole_home_surge_protector`, `uv_germicidal_light`, `media_air_cleaner`, `steam_humidifier`, `condensate_pump` |
| `amount` | The accessory member discount | US dollars, a number with no currency sign, 2 decimal places, always positive, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `install_entry_id` (the new discount entry), `install_id` (the project credited), `source_entry_id` (the accessory charge the discount names), `accessory_code` (the accessory), `amount` (2 decimal places), `posted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `project_balance` (the amount owed once the discount is applied, or null when the project could not be read). A receipt carrying `install_entry_id` means the discount is on the project.

## Illustration (hypothetical contract)

A contract carrying a $295.00 whole-home surge protector charge and a $1195.00 media air cleaner charge receives one discount, naming the $1195.00 media air cleaner charge with `accessory_code` `media_air_cleaner`.
